name: instruction-dispatch-demo
description:
Self-contained, no-validator demo of the openhl-core instruction surface. Every on-chain instruction is dispatched by a 1-byte tag at byte 0 of instruction data; this demo enumerates all 34 tags with their names, categories, and one-line descriptions. Pure Rust against a hand-maintained mirror of `programs/openhl-core/src/lib.rs::process_instruction` — runs in milliseconds, no validator, no deployed program required.

Pairs naturally with `account-layout-demo`: that scenario surfaces the on-chain account types (state model); this one surfaces the instruction surface (operations model). Together they give a buyer the engine's full API at a glance.
headline: 34-instruction dispatch table; tags contiguous 0..=33 with 13 bring-up + 9 order + 3 position + 3 vault + others — a complete perp DEX in one program.

steps.explanation: Enumerate every openhl-core instruction tag and print the dispatch table grouped by category.
